author: Messul
quote: The moment I started playing it, I cried tears of nostalgia... Thanks to the original Ocarina of Time, video games today are what they are. It's absolutely beautiful, full of incredible details. The water looks stunning, the story, the music, everything!!!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Messul
quote: I waited so long for this game, only to be disappointed. It's full of bugs, cutscenes, and everything we're trying to eradicate from humanity. This game actually promotes it all. It brings nothing new or innovative to the gaming industry. It offers nothing truly memorable or groundbreaking that could stand the test of time and be passed down from generation to generation.
